---
title: "Practical_2_Data_Frames_and_Plots/visualisation_exercise"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)

```

```{r}

# Read the data

locations <- read.csv("data/Arctic and red fox coexistence at the edge of Arctic.csv") |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(date = as_date(timestamp))

gt(head(locations))

colnames(locations)

```

```{r}

#Process data

locations.processed <- locations |>
  select(date,individual_local_identifier, individual_taxon_canonical_name, location_long, location_lat) |>
  group_by(date, individual_local_identifier, individual_taxon_canonical_name) |>
  rename(Taxon = individual_taxon_canonical_name, Individual = individual_local_identifier) |>
  summarise(
    Latitude = median(location_lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    Longitude = median(location_long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
gt(locations.processed)
dim(locations.processed)


```
```{r}

min_long <- locations.processed |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
    min()
  

max_long <- locations.processed |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
    max()

min_lati <- locations.processed |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
    min()

max_lati <- locations.processed |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
    max()

ggplot(locations.processed, aes(
  x = Longitude,
  y = Latitude,
  colour = Taxon)) + 
  annotation_borders(fill = "darkgreen", colour = "grey40",
               alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size=0.1)+
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_long - 0.5, max_long + 0.5), ylim = c(min_lati - 0.5, max_lati +0.5)) +
  ggtitle("Artic fox and Red fox \n coexistence at the edge of Artic") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)")+
  ylab("Latitude(°)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "left")+
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("steelblue", 0.2)))
  



```

```{r}

ggplot(locations.processed, aes(
  x = Longitude,
  y = Latitude,
  colour = Individual)) + 
  annotation_borders(fill = "darkgreen", colour = "grey40",
               alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size=0.1)+
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_long - 0.5, max_long + 0.5), ylim = c(min_lati - 0.5, max_lati +0.5)) +
  ggtitle("Arctic fox and Red fox \n coexistence at the edge of Artic") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)")+
  ylab("Latitude(°)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "left")+
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("steelblue", 0.2))) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2,
                               override.aes = list(size = 2)))

  
```
